reconciliation_rules: The user's November3 authorization now permits actual Agentica issue creation/implementation/stable merges; October4 publication-only restrictions describe that earlier planning event.
Approved October4 typed-obligation direction is distinct from current implementation. Plans do not establish runtime availability.
The October15 memory-construction document is a proposed first provider-library adoption, while historical evidence remains first MCP conformance proof. No Bridge adoption is authorized here.
Preserve existing constructors and unopted-in callers; reuse PlanningFrame, EvidenceRef, Artifact, TaskAcceptanceResult and existing runner.
Stable semantic definitions may be reused. Current source eligibility, grants, readiness, resources, acceptance and outstanding attempts are rechecked.
Provider-native opaque state is not user-display thought, durable domain evidence or a portable cross-provider reasoning format.
Publish leaves after fresh existing issue/PR reconciliation. Do not create new issues for record-existing/link-existing entries.
Root must replace evidence placeholders with actual source/head/test outcomes at implementation closure; no fixture counts imply live/provider or other-host acceptance.

epics.title: Obligation contracts, semantic realization and existing-runtime integration
epics.outcome: Introduce the smallest optional obligation/evidence/fulfillment expression, prove it through existing Agentica boundaries, and add realization matching only after two-host falsification.
epics.closure: C-01/C-02 qualify two distinct synthetic hosts; C-03 has its own disposition. No obligation database or universal IR is required.

epics.title: Provider, capability and custody correctness for host integration
epics.outcome: Remove generic adapter/schema/usage/readiness ambiguity before external hosts depend on it.
epics.closure: Affected offline adapter/host seams pass with honest limits; any missing live-provider evidence remains explicit. External Bridge correctness packets retain independent ownership.

epics.title: Exact interpretation reuse and evidence-qualified recovery
epics.outcome: Reuse compatible interpretation while keeping evidence, consumer fulfillment and original attempt custody separate.
epics.closure: Matched exact reuse and invalidation/recovery countercases pass in an isolated host. Interpreted recovery remains optional unless measured useful.

epics.title: Lab and provider qualification with coherent product truth
epics.outcome: Consolidate existing work, preserve the full streaming loop and publish current evidence-qualified status.
epics.closure: Source/runtime/fixture/live claims are separated, existing work is linked rather than duplicated, applicable stable changes reach main with exact-head review evidence.

epics.title: Nyx learning corpus, MCP faculty and independent cognition seam
epics.outcome: Learn through synthetic reference scenarios and an independently runnable Agentica host while existing Nyx and Bridge stay untouched.
epics.closure: Agentica-side NL-01–04 have explicit qualified dispositions. This does not close future host adoption NL-05 or retirement NL-06.
